div.div: مِصْوَلَةٌ A broom (مِكْنَسَةٌ, O, K) with which the sides of the بَيْدَر [or collected wheat or grain, or perhaps the place in which wheat or grain is trodden out,] are swept [to clear it of rubbish]: (O, TA:) so says IAar. (TA. [See also what next precedes.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
